type_text:
∀ {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ),
  1 ≤ R →
    ∀ (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ContinuousOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          (∀ k < m,
              OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V k
                  (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V) k).starts ≠
                none) →
            ∀ (T : ℝ),
              0 ≤ T →
                ↑R ≤
                    ∑ i,
                      ↑⌊V i T / 4 -
                            V i
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R
                                    (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V) m).clock /
                              4⌋ →
                  (∀ k < m + R,
                      OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V k
                          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V)
                              k).starts ≠
                        none) ∧
                    (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V)
                          (m + R)).clock ≤
                      T
